title: memoforge brief/reviews/r<N>-fidelity.json
description: D-223: the fidelity review of a decision brief (`/memoforge:brief`), written by `brief-fidelity-reviewer`: whether the brief says what the memorandum says. `reasoning` is emitted as the first key. The checklist ids are those of `lib/checklists/brief-fidelity.json`; full and unique coverage, the issue each failed blocker or major item needs, and `block` against the blocks this brief actually has are checked by the brief driver, not here.

draft_sha.description: sha256 of the brief version under review, copied from the dispatch prompt.

verdict.description: `approved` means no blocker and no major issue.

block.description: The brief block the issue sits in (`brief_lint.BLOCK_IDS`), or `document` for the brief as a whole.

brief_quote.description: The brief's words, verbatim; empty only when the brief has none to quote (a memo conclusion it leaves out).

memo_quote.description: The memo's words, verbatim; empty only when the memo has none to quote (a statement it never makes).
